strings.species.fauna.mist_manta.name: Mist manta
strings.species.fauna.mist_manta.field_note: A five-meter aerial filter feeder that rides the mineral mist. Its wing membranes taste the air before it commits to a current. Mantas avoid scan pulses that are too strong; a patient observer is rewarded with a slow pass.
strings.species.fauna.mist_manta.hint: At dusk, watch the mist above the tidal flat. The manta's silhouette breaks the light like a moving stain.
strings.species.fauna.tide_grazer.name: Tide grazer
strings.species.fauna.tide_grazer.field_note: A placid herbivore that follows the tide line and grazes saltreed and heather. It has no defensive weapon and very little fear. The settlement's herders track them by the sound of chewing.
strings.species.fauna.tide_grazer.hint: Find the fresh bite marks on saltreed. The grazer is usually within sight of its last meal.
strings.species.fauna.shell_crawler.name: Shell crawler
strings.species.fauna.shell_crawler.field_note: A shy detritivore that builds a house from shed shell and glassbell shards. It is a recycler, not a pest. Turning over its shelter stone can expose it to predators for weeks.
strings.species.fauna.shell_crawler.hint: Look for small trails in the wet sand and a shell that moves against the wind.
strings.species.fauna.glasswing.name: Glasswing
strings.species.fauna.glasswing.field_note: A thumb-sized pollinator with transparent wings. It is curious about lenses and will hover close enough to inspect one. The species pollinates glassbell and crystal thistle in the same flight.
strings.species.fauna.glasswing.hint: Stand still near a flowering glassbell. The wings catch the light before the body does.
strings.species.fauna.echo_moth.name: Echo moth
strings.species.fauna.echo_moth.field_note: A night pollinator that navigates by returning its own click. Bright flares disorient it for hours. The ash orchid depends on the moth's route through the dark.
strings.species.fauna.echo_moth.hint: At night, follow the soft ticking sound near ash orchids. Do not use a flare.
strings.species.fauna.salt_fox.name: Salt fox
strings.species.fauna.salt_fox.field_note: A cautious scavenger with a narrow range along the heath. It remembers easy food and avoids camps that leave scraps. Observing one is mostly a matter of being boring.
strings.species.fauna.salt_fox.hint: Check the edge of the heath at dusk. If it sees you first, you will only see the grass move.
strings.species.fauna.reef_singer.name: Reef singer
strings.species.fauna.reef_singer.field_note: A social coastal animal that communicates through low-frequency song. Its calls carry through the hull of a landed ship. The singer's nursery is the lumen kelp canopy, which makes the kelp a neighbour rather than a resource.
strings.species.fauna.reef_singer.hint: Listen for a pattern of three descending notes near the water. Answering with a scan pulse often brings one closer.
strings.species.fauna.ash_heron.name: Ash heron
strings.species.fauna.ash_heron.field_note: A patient wading predator with a two-meter wingspan. It hunts by standing still, which makes it easy to mistake for a rock. A hunting heron should be given fifty meters; a nest should be given more.
strings.species.fauna.ash_heron.hint: Scan the far bank during dawn. Look for a shape that does not move when everything else does.
strings.species.fauna.mote_swarm.name: Mote swarm
strings.species.fauna.mote_swarm.field_note: A drifting cloud of tiny spore-eaters. The swarm is a single ecological act, not a single animal. Walking around it protects the spore cycle that keeps the canopy alive.
strings.species.fauna.mote_swarm.hint: Look for a slow golden haze above the moss. The swarm moves with the air, not against it.
strings.species.fauna.hollow_crab.name: Hollow crab
strings.species.fauna.hollow_crab.field_note: A territorial shell builder that engineers the crystal flats. It gathers shed spines and glues them into shelter mounds. Those mounds become nurseries for smaller animals. Do not take an occupied shell.
strings.species.fauna.hollow_crab.hint: Search the crystal flats for mounds with a single dark opening. Listen for a dry clicking inside.
strings.species.fauna.night_drifter.name: Night drifter
strings.species.fauna.night_drifter.field_note: A soft-bodied plankton grazer that rises from the shallows after dark. Its pulse is a response to the moon, not to you. Lifting one above the waterline can collapse its body.
strings.species.fauna.night_drifter.hint: At night, scan just above the water. The drifter's bell catches starlight like a weak lamp.
strings.species.fauna.stilt_walker.name: Stilt walker
strings.species.fauna.stilt_walker.field_note: A three-meter browser that crosses the dry ridge in small herds. It eats star cactus arms and spreads the seeds in its droppings. Never stand between a stilt and its herd.
strings.species.fauna.stilt_walker.hint: At dusk, watch the horizon of the dry ridge. The walkers move in a line, not a scatter.
